name: myway
description: A single-page movie discovery app built on the [TMDB API](https://www.themoviedb.org/documentation/api). It was built as a 3rd-semester project, with one distinguishing idea: instead of showing only Hollywood movies (the default for most TMDB demo apps), every section of the app **deliberately interleaves popular English and Hindi cinema 50/50** — a home "Spotlight," genre categories, and search results all give equal real estate to Bollywood and Hollywood.
